speaker: Doctor
text: What is the appearance of your rash, and have you noticed any scaling or vesicles on your hands? Additionally, have you ever been exposed to poison ivy, oak, or other plants?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your farming history and the combination of a pruritic rash with hand numbness, I need to clarify if the rash appeared after contact with plants or if it is symmetric. Also, has anyone else in your household developed similar symptoms?

REQUEST TEST: Blood smear for Leishmania, Skin biopsy for histoplasmosis or leprosy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood smear for Leishmania: Negative; Skin biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.
